newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gasoline firms in late trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gasoline firms in late trade.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Monday.
Gas oil cargo premiums were a touch firmer on some supply tighness, but attention was mainly focussed on diesel.
High sulphur fuel oil cargoes lost $1 to $2 of Friday's gain while barges slipped $1 earlier before pegging back to $83-$84 fob. Low sulphur was steady in a very thin market.
Gasoline was flat to slightly firmer with Eurograde barges trading at $190 and $191, while regular traded at $180 and $185.
Naphtha was in the doldrums as prices in the Asian markets, which have been its sole consolation recently, collapsed.
